 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Stephen Curry has made it clear that he is not pleased with the criticism directed at his wife, Ayesha Curry, following the release of her new movie. The Golden State Warriors superstar addressed the growing conversation involving former NBA players Nick Young and Gilbert Arenas, along with former NFL player Emmanuel Acho and others who have shared their opinions about her.
 The controversy began after Ayesha appeared in the Roku romantic comedy "Second Chance Holiday," which features an on-screen kissing scene with co-star Matthew Daddario. The scene attracted criticism from several sports personalities, with LeSean McCoy questioning her decision to participate in it.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Arenas also took aim at Ayesha during an appearance on the We Said What We Said podcast with Young, calling her the only blemish in Stephen's family and arguing that she does not behave like other NBA stars' wives.
 MORE: Warriors accomplish feat no NBA team has ever done 
 Steph Curry tells critics to keep Ayesha's name out of their mouths
 Golden State Warriors guard Stephen Curry. Mandatory Credit: Kelley L Cox-Imagn Images
 Stephen addressed the criticism in a video, explaining that the conversation had gone beyond the usual noise surrounding his family.
 "I've been hearing a lot of noise, and usually the noise doesn't bother me or Ayesha," Curry said. "But this one in particular, when people are trying to step on the accomplishments of my wife, leading podcasts and giving opinions on somebody else's wife, I don't know why Nick, Gil, Emmanuel and anybody else feel the need to jump in and give an opinion on something they don't really know about."
 The Warriors star also suggested the comments revealed a bigger issue with how some people view women and what they believe women should be allowed to do.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Curry made his message particularly clear when addressing those who continue to use Ayesha's name in their headlines.
 "Anytime Ayesha Curry shows up in your headline, I'd kindly suggest you give the happy hands, the congratulations and, maybe, an apology as loud as you lead your shows with this topic," he said.
 He ended by thanking the critics for the free publicity.
 Ayesha Curry stars alongside Matthew Daddario in Second Chance Holiday
 Ayesha's latest project premiered on Nov. 5 on The Roku Channel and is her first leading role in a feature film.
 Ayesha plays Chelsey, a dating expert who believes she is cursed after repeatedly getting dumped during the holiday season. However, her outlook changes when she reconnects with her high school flame, played by Daddario, and begins to wonder whether her bad luck could lead her back to her first love.
